status: isolated engineering draft; no formal native or learning release
model_configuration: optional explicit wait_mode=fixed|events; omission retains legacy config identity and weights
paired_capacity: both explicit modes instantiate the same condition head and 20-to-64 previous-result projection
initialization: append new weights under restored CPU RNG state, private seed 50212; preserve every legacy parameter and caller RNG stream; verify paired equality for seeds 0,1,2

policy.factorization: p(type) * p(maximum|belief) * p(condition|belief) on event wait rows; fixed rows omit the condition factor; plant/shovel unchanged
policy.entropy: existing chosen-branch entropy plus condition categorical entropy only for event wait rows
policy.control_compute: fixed control has the same condition logits and context projection, but condition sampling/loss is unused

previous_wait_context.destination: add to existing 64-dimensional previous-action vector before the unchanged GRU
previous_wait_context.reset: previous action/result absent and actual elapsed ticks zero; entire extra context exactly zero
previous_wait_context.time: actual public board tick delta, including zero; not requested maximum or number of logic calls
previous_wait_context.result_checks: explicit fields, version, condition, request, actual ticks and simultaneous precedence; validate final transitions too

trajectory.storage: new explicit models require both fields, with null for non-event actions; NPZ JSON metadata preserves every field
trajectory.digest: include optional result fields in both digest paths; absent fields retain legacy digest bytes
trajectory.discount: unchanged gamma^(actual_ticks/300); GAE lambda uses the same actual duration
trajectory.evaluation: environment selected from saved config; retain raw waits and separate requested/actual time, zero duration and all reasons

synthetic_cpu_contracts.fixture: two synthetic recurrent episodes, 11 and 8 decisions, mixed plant/shovel/wait; six event conditions; unequal actual waits
synthetic_cpu_contracts.optimizer: actual small CPU AdamW train_update with current recurrence and 3-decision chunks; not a CPU fallback for CUDA experiments
synthetic_cpu_contracts.restore: synthetic full state/AdamW/all RNG next-update equality; no process SIGKILL or native claim
synthetic_cpu_contracts.delivery: raw synthetic checkpoints/shards remain in ignored artifacts/research; only KB report enters git
